title: How /implement turns the spec into verified code
subtitle: Ten steps, deterministic gates throughout, and a complete record saved to disk.
banner: The model can claim success. Lightsout requires evidence.

cards.title: START THE RUN
bullets: Hand the finished plan to `/implement`
Resolve settings from the config
Snapshot existing worktree changes and create a run ID
Create a repository lock so other lightsout runs cannot clash
cards.note: Isolates the agent’s changes and makes the run safely resumable

cards.title: VERIFY THE REPO STARTS GREEN
bullets: Run lint, type checks, tests, build, and coverage before implementation begins
Stop immediately if any gate is already failing
Record files touched by setup or gates in the manifest
cards.note: Proves any later failure was introduced by this run, not inherited from the repository

cards.title: IMPLEMENT THE PLAN
bullets: The implementation agent follows the finished spec
It writes the code and returns a structured report
It can run only commands explicitly allowed in the config
cards.note: Executes the finished spec without reopening settled decisions

cards.title: VERIFY THE IMPLEMENTATION
bullets: Re-run lint, type checks, tests, build, and coverage
Try up to two lightweight repairs if a gate fails
If the gates remain red, park the run with all evidence
cards.note: Prevents a broken implementation from moving forward

cards.title: WRITE THE TESTS
bullets: Spawn a test-writing agent for each source file that changed
Add tests until coverage meets the configured threshold
Skip this step when no eligible source files changed
cards.note: Makes sure the new behavior is covered by tests

cards.title: VERIFY THE TESTS
bullets: Re-run lint, type checks, tests, build, and coverage
Try up to two lightweight repairs if a gate fails
cards.note: Confirms the new tests pass and coverage meets the configured threshold

cards.title: REFACTOR
bullets: Review changed code for duplication and structural issues
Reuse existing helpers or extract shared abstractions
Refactor to your code standards without changing behavior
Skip this step when requested or when nothing changed
cards.note: Removes duplication and keeps agent-written code aligned with your code standards

cards.title: VERIFY THE REFACTOR
bullets: Re-run lint, type checks, tests, build, and coverage
Try up to two lightweight repairs if a gate fails
cards.note: Confirms the refactor preserved behavior and passes every gate

cards.title: FORMAT THE CODE
bullets: Run the configured formatter on all changed files
Re-run lint, type checks, tests, build, and coverage
cards.note: Confirms formatting does not break a green run

cards.title: REPORT THE RESULT
bullets: Generate the final report from artifacts saved during the run
Record the final status, steps, retries, rejected reports, token cost, and friction
Keep the complete run history in one folder
cards.note: Leaves an inspectable record of what happened and why the run passed or failed
